name: tabletop-ir
description: Incident response tabletop simulator: branching ransomware and fraud scenarios with a simulated clock, regulatory deadlines (NIS2, GDPR), scoring and an after-action report that compares your decisions with the best possible path. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: tsc && node --test dist/test/scenario.test.js dist/test/engine.test.js dist/test/analysis.test.js dist/test/report.test.js dist/test/server.test.js dist/test/browser-api.test.js
